entities.title: A pass through a real repository
entities.summary: There are no automated tests of the page; it is checked by hand in a browser.
criteria: Every kind of view and knowledge file in the repository shows, and nothing is listed as skipped that should not be.
Every drawing lays out, pans, zooms, lights neighbours, inspects and drills.
Links between views and records land where they say.
There are no errors in the browser's console.

checks.description: Open a public repository with every kind of view, such as retro-games, and walk each folder and tab.
Open the same page in dark mode, with reduced motion, and in full browser windows at about 1440 × 900, 2560 × 1440 and 3440 × 1440.
Block cdn.jsdelivr.net and check that every view falls back to its tables.
Open a private repository, add a token, browse, then forget it.

entities.title: This description stays valid
entities.summary: The validators check this folder's .dev files against the skills' and the catalogue's schemas.
criteria: Every .dev file here matches its schema, and every path and symbol it cites exists.
